name: PDF pages
description: Render PDF pages to images so an agent can look at charts, diagrams and scans instead of reading text that was never extracted.

presets.label: Render pages as images
presets.description: First 6 pages at 120 dpi — enough to read a chart, small enough to send (pdftoppm names the files itself: <prefix>-01.png, -02.png …)

presets.label: Render pages as images (higher detail)
presets.description: First 3 pages at 200 dpi — for dense tables or small print (pdftoppm names the files itself: <prefix>-01.png, -02.png …)
